## Technical Capabilities & Core Stack

### Frontend Engineering
- **Angular**: Micro-frontends (Nx Monorepos), RxJS, Dynamic Forms, Shared UI Libraries.
- **Next.js & React**: App Router, SSR/SSG, SEO & Core Web Vitals Optimization, Modular TypeScript Components.
- **TypeScript & Web**: Strict typing, generic design systems, responsive Tailwind CSS layouts.

### Backend & Microservices
- **Java / Spring Boot**: Microservices architecture, Spring Security, RESTful APIs, JPA/Hibernate, Keycloak OIDC/RBAC, BPM/CRM integrations.
- **Go (Golang)**: Concurrent goroutines, high-throughput microservices, developer CLI tooling.
- **Event Streaming & Cache**: Apache Kafka (distributed event streams), Redis (in-memory caching, session store, distributed locking).
- **Storage & IAM**: MinIO (Object Storage), Keycloak (Identity & Access Management).

### Databases & Query Tuning
- **Oracle Database**: Enterprise schema design, SQL query tuning, stored procedures, execution plan analysis.
- **PostgreSQL**: Relational modeling, composite indexing, connection pool optimization (HikariCP).

### DevOps, Kubernetes & Homelab Infrastructure
- **Kubernetes & K3s**: Multi-node bare-metal/virtualized Homelab cluster, Longhorn distributed persistent block storage, Traefik Ingress, rolling zero-downtime releases.
- **Containers & CI/CD**: Docker (multi-stage caching builds), private container registries, Jenkins declarative pipelines.
- **Linux Administration**: Ubuntu Server, CoreDNS troubleshooting, networking, Cloudflare tunnels.

## Featured Systems & Technical Case Studies

### 1. EPAS — Enterprise Process Automation System (NGV Group, 12/2024 – Present)
- **Problem**: Multiple enterprise business modules required independent release cycles with unified authentication, shared UI design systems, and automated BPM workflows.
- **Architecture**: Angular Shell (Nx Monorepo) ──► Module Federation ──► CRM/BPM Remotes ──► Spring Boot Microservices ──► Oracle/PostgreSQL & Kafka/Redis.
- **Deliverables**: Shared `@shared/ui-lib`, dynamic form engine, transaction inboxes, Jenkins declarative pipeline, zero-downtime Kubernetes deployments.

### 2. Enterprise CI/CD & 3-Node Kubernetes (K3s) Homelab Infrastructure (2024 – Present)
- **Problem**: Need for deterministic, automated container deployment pipelines and a resilient multi-node cluster with persistent distributed block storage.
- **Architecture**: Internet/Cloudflare ──► Traefik Ingress ──► 3-Node K3s Cluster ──► Longhorn Storage Volume (2x replication) ──► Git Push to Jenkins to Registry to K8s Rollout.
- **Deliverables**: Automated Docker layer caching, declarative Jenkinsfile, Longhorn distributed storage, cluster health monitoring and rolling updates.

### 3. Zalo OA Message Management Platform (NGV Group, 12/2024 – Present)
- **Deliverables**: High-performance conversation management console, broadcast templates, webhook synchronization, Spring Boot & Redis session caching.

### 4. MochiMochi Language Learning Platform (MochiMochi, 03/2024 – 08/2024)
- **Deliverables**: Next.js learner-facing web app, Core Web Vitals optimization, SSR pipeline, and modular TypeScript components.
